# `lakana task-token`

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_reference.py from the Typer app. Do not edit by hand:
run `uv run python scripts/generate_reference.py` and commit the result. -->

Part of the [Command line reference](../cli.md), which lists the options for every command.

Usage: `lakana task-token [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...`

Mint and revoke task tokens.

## `lakana task-token mint`

Usage: `lakana task-token mint [OPTIONS] {principal}`

Mint a task token for PRINCIPAL; the token is shown once.

PRINCIPAL is your own name, unless you are an instance admin.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PRINCIPAL` | text | required |  |
| `--scope` | text, repeatable | required | Asset pattern, e.g. bronze.* (repeatable). |
| `--ttl` | whole number, 1 or more | required | Lifetime in seconds. |
| `--env` | text | none | Environment (default: the profile's). |

## `lakana task-token revoke`

Usage: `lakana task-token revoke [OPTIONS] {key_id}`

Revoke task token KEY_ID.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `KEY_ID` | text | required |  |
| `--yes` | flag | off | Don't ask for confirmation. |
